Description:
The Ublives® SoleFlux Relax is an innovative device that relieves leg pain and associated discomfort using a sophisticated mechanism based on air pressure technology. The device applies gentle yet effective pressure to the legs, promoting lymphatic blood circulation and normalizing blood flow at the distal end. This helps to reduce swelling, ease pain, and improve overall leg health.

On the surface of the SoleFlux Relax, there are carefully designed pressure zones that are strategically placed to target specific areas of the legs. These pressure zones work together to provide a comprehensive massage experience that can be customized to meet the individual needs of each user.

As soon as the SoleFlux Relax is activated, it begins to work by inflating and deflating in a controlled manner, applying pressure to the legs and stimulating the muscles and nerves. The pressure can be adjusted to different levels, allowing users to choose the intensity that is most comfortable for them.

The ultimate goal of this inventive technology is to relieve leg pain and discomfort without causing any adverse side effects. By promoting muscular relaxation and improving blood circulation, the SoleFlux Relax can help to reduce fatigue, improve mobility, and provide relief for people suffering from various leg conditions such as edema, varicose veins, and chronic pain.
